units.name: Elise
desc: Transform into Spider Form, gaining Health. Fire webbing at the enemy that dealt the most damage this round, stunning the first enemy hit and dealing magic damage. Subsequent casts heal, then fire webbing.

units.name: Gnar
desc: Passive: Every 3rd attack is replaced with a rock that deals physical damage and grants Gnar Attack Speed.

units.name: Katarina
desc: Twirl, slashing adjacent enemies for magic damage, then eviscerate the current target for magic damage. Enemies hit are Captivated, and Captivated enemies grant bonuses to Classical champions.

units.name: Kayn
desc: Dash and swipe, dealing physical damage to enemies in a 2-hex line. With the Heartsteel upgrade, transform into the Shadow Assassin at a health threshold, briefly becoming untargetable and dealing bonus magic damage for the rest of combat.

units.name: Kennen
desc: Passive: Reduce all incoming damage. Every second, zap adjacent enemies, dealing magic damage.

units.name: Kobuko
desc: Passive: Your strongest Kobuko gains bonus Health based on Hyperpop Hype.
Active: Amp Up, healing each second for the duration.
unlock: Reach the required star level on Ziggs and equip the required number of items to him.

units.name: Lillia
desc: Heals and strikes the target, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and weakening them for a duration. Weakening reduces damage dealt.

units.name: Neeko
desc: Convene the K/DA fan club and throw confetti streams at the target, each dealing magic damage. If a stream kills, permanently gain Ability Power.

units.name: Olaf
desc: Passive: On attack, heal. On death, instead heal to full and gain Attack Speed, but lose a percentage of maximum Health each second.

units.name: Sett
desc: Passive: Gain more maximum Health from all sources.
Active: Heal, then strike the target twice, dealing physical damage with each hit.
Heartsteel Upgrade: Periodically heal a portion of maximum Health, increased based on missing Health.

units.name: Taric
desc: Grant a shield to Taric and a nearby damaged ally for a duration.

units.name: Varus
desc: Fire a hail of arrows, dealing physical damage to the target and damage to adjacent enemies. Slow them, reducing their Attack Speed.

units.name: Yunara
desc: For the rest of combat, attacks fire an additional orb that deals physical damage.

units.name: Ziggs
desc: Passive: Attacks deal bonus magic damage.
Active: Throw a bomb at the target, dealing magic damage to them and adjacent enemies.

units.name: Zoe
desc: Fires a paddle ball backwards, then redirects it toward the farthest enemy, dealing magic damage to the first enemy hit. If that enemy dies, the ball ricochets to the next enemy hit and deals excess damage.

units.name: Annie
desc: Gain a shield, then unleash a cone of fire that deals magic damage to enemies and Burns and Wounds them for 4 seconds.

units.name: Ashe
desc: Her next attacks gain Attack Speed and become flurries of arrows. Each arrow deals physical damage.
unlock: Equip the required number of items to a Beach Pop champion.

units.name: Camille
desc: Passive: When the target dies, hookshot to the next target and deal physical damage to them.
Active: Sweep-kick in a cone, dealing physical damage.

units.name: Ezreal
desc: Fire a missile that marks the target, then launch a second blast that detonates the mark, dealing physical damage to the target and units within 1 Hex.
Heartsteel Upgrade: The detonation deals increased damage. Every 3rd cast hits enemies within a 2 Hex radius instead.

units.name: Gragas
desc: Become boisterous, restoring Health each second and dealing bonus magic damage on attack. For each 3-star K/DA ally, both effects increase.

units.name: Illaoi
desc: Active: Heal and deal magic damage in a 2-hex line.
Quest: On cast during player combat, gain Fame, with bonus Fame for every 10g you have up to a gold cap. At the Fame threshold, go Platinum, gaining Durability and dropping gold on cast instead.

units.name: Jax
desc: Bash the current target, dealing magic damage and healing for a percentage of damage dealt. Gain Attack Speed for the rest of combat.
EDM Upgrade: Fire beams at nearby enemies, dealing magic damage reduced for each enemy the beams pass through.

units.name: Karthus
desc: After a brief delay, deal magic damage to the current target. If they die, recast this ability at reduced effectiveness.

units.name: Lucian
desc: Dash to a nearby hex, then fire 2 shots at the target, each dealing physical damage.

units.name: Lulu
desc: Rotate between two effects: Whimsy! grants an ally decaying Attack Speed and deals magic damage on hit. Wild Growth increases an ally’s Health; while active, adjacent enemies take magic damage each second.
unlock: Have your Hyperpop champions cast the required number of times with the trait active.

units.name: Lux
desc: Toss a prism into the air and blast it with a beam of light. The beam splits, dealing magic damage to the target and another nearby enemy. Gain Mana for each enemy killed.

units.name: Nasus
desc: Create a magnificent hex field that lasts several seconds. While active, heal each second, and allies within the field heal. Enemies take magic damage and are Captivated if they have less maximum Health than Nasus. Captivated enemies grant bonuses to Classical champions.
unlock: Equip the required number of items to a Classical champion.

units.name: Qiyana
desc: Passive: Qiyana’s ring changes color periodically, granting her ability different bonus effects.

Active: Dash through enemies in a line, dealing physical damage to the target and other enemies hit. Red deals bonus damage; Green heals based on damage dealt; Blue refunds mana; Gold grants gold and randomly applies one of the other effects.

units.name: Renata Glasc
desc: Fires a musical bar at the target, applying Toxin stacks that deal magic damage over time. Also applies Toxin to nearby enemies, prioritizing unpoisoned enemies. Enemies are Captivated when Toxin is applied; the effect lasts longer if their star level is less than or equal to Renata’s. Captivated enemies grant bonuses to Classical champions.
unlock: Equip the required number of items to a Classical or Choreographer champion.

units.name: Renekton
desc: Grow larger, gaining max Health for the rest of combat. Then spin, dealing physical damage to adjacent enemies.

units.name: Samira
desc: Passive: When Samira critically strikes an enemy, they become Captivated.
Active: Fire bullets at the current target, each dealing physical damage. Captivated enemies grant bonuses to Classical champions.
unlock: Equip the required number of items to a Classical, Renegade, or Trickshot champion.

units.name: Seraphine
desc: Indie: Release a stream of notes at the target while posing for the fans, dealing magic damage over 2.5 seconds.
Rising Star: Release bonus notes at nearby enemies.
Superstar: Toss high notes at every enemy.
unlock: Reroll the required number of times before the Stage 2 Carousel.

units.name: Tristana
desc: Throw bombs at nearby enemies and detonate them, dealing physical damage. The final blast deals different physical damage.
unlock: Get the required number of kills with Hyperpop active.

units.name: Amumu
desc: Heal and toss bandages at the nearest enemies, dealing magic damage and stunning them.

units.name: Bard
desc: Passive: Gain the Horn of the Traveler. While equipped, casts generate XP and attacks grant bonus Mana.
Active: Summon a wave of meeps that deals magic damage to enemies hit, with damage reduced for each enemy it passes through.

units.name: Braum
desc: Gain a shield, then slam the ground, dealing magic damage to adjacent enemies and stunning them.

units.name: Briar
desc: Heals and kicks a snack at the furthest enemy within range. Dashes toward it, dealing physical damage in an area. Then chow downs, gaining Attack Speed for the next several attacks and replacing them with slashes that deal physical damage.

units.name: Draven
units.ability: You Spin Me Round (Like An Axe)
desc: Throws a massive spinning record at the target, dealing physical damage. It leaves behind a vortex that deals physical damage per second, split among enemies within 1 hex.

units.name: Ekko
desc: Passive: Rewinds a portion of damage taken over time.
Active: Instantly heals all damage being rewound and restores bonus Health, then deals magic damage to the current target.

units.name: Evelynn
desc: Passive: At combat start, teleport behind the current target and become enshrouded for a duration. While enshrouded, become untargetable to attacks and gain Durability if enough other allies are alive.
Active: Deal magic damage to the current target and other enemies in a semi-circle, ignoring a portion of their Magic Resist.
unlock: Field the required number of K/DA or Renegade champions.

units.name: Galio
desc: Gain a shield for a duration. Fire wind at the enemy who dealt the most damage this fight, dealing magic damage and stunning them for a duration.
unlock: Have the required number of Bodyguard, Juggernaut, or Frontman traits active.
Level 7

units.name: K'Sante
desc: Gain a shield, then charge and push the target, stunning them and other enemies hit before slamming them for physical damage. After charging, taunt nearby enemies.
Heartsteel Upgrade: Gain Armor and Magic Resist and deal bonus physical damage on attack.

units.name: Kai'Sa
desc: Passive: Every few attacks, fire missiles that deal physical damage.
Active: Gain Attack Speed for the rest of combat.

units.name: Malzahar
desc: Fire a beam at the target, dealing magic damage over time. The energy rhythmically explodes 4 times, reducing the Magic Resist of enemies in an area and dealing magic damage with each explosion.

units.name: Senna
desc: Blast the target, dealing physical damage and marking them. If they’re already marked, detonate the mark instead, dealing damage. Detonating the mark or killing a marked enemy grants Damage Amp until the end of combat.

units.name: Swain
desc: Enter Demon Form, gaining max Health and dealing magic damage to adjacent enemies every second. Subsequent casts heal and increase the damage.

units.name: Syndra
desc: Spike a volleyball at the target, dealing magic damage. It bounces to the enemy behind them with the fewest items, dealing magic damage.
unlock: Field the required number of unique star levels of Beach Pop or Choreographer.

units.name: Tibbers
desc: Passive: At low health or when your strongest Annie dies, become enraged, gaining max Health, Attack Damage, and Attack Speed that decays over time.
Active: Gain a shield for a fixed duration. If enraged, refresh the decaying Attack Speed.
unlock: Reach the required star level on Annie and equip the required number of items to her.

units.name: Viego
desc: Summon swords around the target, then impale them after a brief delay, dealing physical damage per sword. Gain a permanent sword every set number of takedowns.

units.name: Ahri
desc: Passive: Start combat with fox-fires and gain more after casting, up to a limit. Then enter a flow state, moving faster and empowering subsequent casts.

Active: Launch all fox-fires at the target, each dealing magic damage. While in the flow state, launch a heart at the target that deals magic damage and split the fox-fires among enemies near the target.

units.name: Alistar
units.ability: Blue Cow Crying in the Rain
desc: Heal, with the amount increased based on missing Health. Then slam the target, knocking up nearby enemies and dealing magic damage to all enemies hit.
unlock: A Chain Vest equipped to a Caster or Marksman.
Level 7

units.name: Alune
desc: Call down a spotlight on the target, dealing magic damage. Nearby enemies split magic damage. If the target dies, excess damage is split among the nearest enemies.
Heartsteel Upgrade: Fire blasts at the target that deal magic damage.
unlock: Field the required number of unique Heartsteel or Prodigy champions.
Level 7

units.name: Aurora
desc: Blink away and fire a blast through the best line, dealing magic damage to the two highest-Health enemies and less magic damage to the rest. Then blink back.

units.name: Garen
desc: Heal, then fire a wave toward the current target, dealing physical damage to enemies hit and weakening them, reducing their damage dealt.

units.name: Graves
desc: For the next attacks, gain Attack Speed, dash to targets, and fire a cone of bullets that each deal physical damage. On a kill, empower an additional attack.

units.name: Jhin
desc: Passive: Convert bonus Attack Speed into Attack Damage. Attacks summon violins that strike in unison, dealing physical damage and captivating the target. Every fourth attack deals empowered physical damage and resets the violins. From the fourth sequence onward, all violins remain out, Jhin gains infinite range, and his attacks pierce targets, dealing reduced damage with each target hit.

units.name: Jinx
desc: Rapidly fire missiles at nearby enemies, each dealing physical damage.
unlock: Equip the required number of items to an Ionic Spark or Hitmaker champion.
Level 7

units.name: Kayle
desc: Passive: Attacks deal bonus magic damage.

Active: Gain Attack Speed and infinite range for a duration, summoning a sword with each attack. Afterwards, rain swords on the target, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and additional magic damage to the target for each sword.
unlock: Field the required number of unique Pentakill or Swiftstriker champions.
Level 7

units.name: Leona
desc: Gain a shield for a duration. Call down beams of light on nearby enemies; each deals magic damage and reduces its target’s Magic Resist.

units.name: Locke
desc: Passive: Attacks deal bonus magic damage. All damage Locke deals to an enemy increases for each mark he has applied to them.
Active: Hurl 3 Soul Nails at the furthest enemy within range, dealing magic damage to and marking all enemies hit. Then teleport to that enemy and deal magic damage.

units.name: Mel
desc: Fire missiles split between the closest enemies, dealing magic damage and applying a stack of Blues to each. For every required stack threshold of Blues, enemies take increased damage from this ability.

units.name: Shyvana
desc: Passive: At a health threshold, transform into Dragon Form. While transformed, gain max Health and Attack Speed, and every third attack deals bonus magic damage in a 1-hex area.
Active: Gain a Shield for a duration.

units.name: Thresh
desc: Passive: Periodically Captivate the farthest enemy who isn’t already Captivated.
Active: Heal, then drain max Health from nearby enemies over time. While draining, gain Durability. Captivated enemies grant bonuses to Classical champions.
unlock: Have enemies spend the required number of seconds Captivated by Classical.

units.name: Vayne
desc: Passive: On cast or when hit, tumble and gain Durability for a duration (cooldown applies).
Active: Gain demonic power, enhancing the next attacks to deal physical damage based on Attack Damage and the target’s max Health.
unlock: Field Rock for the required number of combats.
Level 7

units.name: Wukong
units.ability: The Tricks of the Many Mythical Tricksters
desc: Heals Wukong and sends out clones in a 2-Hex circle that quickly return. Clones steal Armor and Magic Resist from enemies they pass through and deal physical damage. When they return, Wukong gains the stolen defenses.
unlock: Have allies deal the required damage while fielding Xayah.

units.name: Xayah
units.ability: Feathers Flying Like Leaves on the Wind
desc: Summon feathers that strike the target, each dealing physical damage and reducing its Armor.

units.name: Yasuo
desc: Dash and thrust forward, dealing physical damage to enemies in a line. Every third cast, knock up the target and deal physical damage, then slam them down, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.
unlock: Field the required number of star levels of True Damage and Slayer champions.
Level 7

units.name: Yone
desc: Passive: This ability scales with whichever is higher, Attack Damage or Ability Power. Attacks deal physical damage.
Active: Rapidly strike the target and nearby enemies multiple times, dealing physical damage with each strike, then unleash a massive slash that deals physical damage to the target.
Heartsteel Upgrade: Strike additional times and ignore some of the target’s Armor.

units.name: Yorick
desc: Play an epic solo to restore Health and create a Hex zone that deals magic damage each second to enemies within. The final note deals magic damage to enemies in the zone and Slows them for a duration, reducing their Attack Speed.

units.name: Yuumi
units.ability: Girl, Put Your Records On (Your Head)
desc: Throws a spinning disc that deals magic damage and stacks on the target, reducing their Magic Resist every second. When the stack reaches its required number of discs, it topples, dealing a portion of the stacked discs’ total damage to the target and splitting additional damage among nearby enemies. If an enemy dies with a disc, it passes to another enemy.

units.name: Zac
desc: Charge up, gaining Durability and healing. Then leap and crash onto the target, dealing magic damage to adjacent enemies and briefly knocking them up.
unlock: Field the required number of unique Beach Pop or Juggernaut champions.
Level 7

units.name: Akali (K/DA)
desc: Skateboard through the longest line of unpainted enemies, dealing physical damage to enemies hit and painting them and the hexes along the path. Painted enemies and enemies standing in painted hexes are Vulnerable, increasing damage taken. After every 3rd cast, ignite the paint to deal physical damage to all painted enemies and enemies standing in painted hexes.
unlock: Field the required number of unique star levels of K/DA without True Damage Akali unlocked.

units.name: Akali (True Damage)
desc: B-Side Passive: After every set number of takedowns, gain Player Health.

Active: Rapidly slash through the current target, dealing magic damage, increased against Tanks. While casting, gain Durability and become untargetable by attacks. Then blink over the target and throw a bomb that deals magic damage split among nearby enemies.
unlock: Earn the required True Damage Bling without K/DA Akali unlocked.

units.name: Aphelios
desc: Passive: Gain a Chakram every set number of attacks, up to a maximum. Attacks deal bonus physical damage for each equipped Chakram. After reaching the maximum, gain bonus Attack Damage and infinite range.
Active: Fire bolts at the nearest enemies, dealing physical damage, then split into bolts that damage enemies they pass through. Gain Attack Speed for a duration.
Heartsteel Upgrade: Start combat with Chakrams equipped.
unlock: Reach the required star level on Alune or Yone.

units.name: Dr. Mundo
desc: Passive: While Dr. Mundo has the required amount of max Health, he becomes Pumped Up, gaining max Health and causing attacks to deal bonus magic damage.
Active: Restore Health over time and deal magic damage each second to all nearby enemies.

units.name: Gwen
desc: Passive: Attacks deal bonus magic damage to the target and other enemies in a cone. Dash to new targets.

Active: After a short delay, summon a massive pair of scissors to snip a horizontal line on the target, dealing magic damage to all enemies hit, plus damage split between them. If only a limited number of enemies are hit, refund Mana.
unlock: Have Ionic Spark fans cheer the required number of times.

units.name: Janna
desc: Fire celestial dragons at nearby enemies, dealing magic damage. After several casts, envelop the arena in Heaven’s Gale, dealing magic damage to every enemy over time.
unlock: Earn the required interest while fielding Xayah.

units.name: Lee Sin
units.ability: Celestial Combo To Impress The Heavens
desc: Unleash a combo attack beginning with Dragon Slam; subsequent casts add moves to the sequence. Dragon Slam deals physical damage to the target and reduced physical damage to nearby enemies. Tempest Spin deals physical damage to the target, knocks them up, and deals reduced physical damage to nearby enemies. Celestial Punch deals physical damage and marks the target; if they are already marked, it strikes their core for bonus true damage.
unlock: Deal the required player damage while fielding Xayah.

units.name: Miss Fortune
desc: Fire a pinball toward the target, dealing physical damage. It bounces after hitting an enemy, damaging nearby enemies with reduced damage on each hit until it expires. Damage cannot fall below a minimum.

units.name: Mordekaiser
desc: Briefly gain Durability and summon a claw that deals magic damage in a massive line. The closest enemies take more damage and are pulled toward Mordekaiser. For the rest of combat, gain Omnivamp and Attack Range, and replace attacks with a slam that deals magic damage to the target and nearby enemies.
unlock: Field the required number of unique star levels of Pentakill.

units.name: Nidalee
desc: In Cougar Form, Pounce Party pounces on enemies, dealing magic damage that increases with each pounce. In Human Form, Dance of Life heals, then hurls a javelin at the target for magic damage and scatters flowers around them; after a brief delay, the flowers deal magic damage to enemies nearby.

units.name: Nunu & Willump
desc: Passive: Gain Mana Regen. Slowly roll a Disco Ball, dealing magic damage to all enemies it passes through.
Active: For the rest of combat, move faster and increase the Disco Ball’s size and damage.

units.name: Pyke
units.ability: Execute Gon' Give it to Ya
desc: Passive: When an enemy drops below the health threshold, instantly cast on them, then dash back to the current target.
Active: Deal physical damage to the target and to other enemies in an X shape. Execute enemies below the health threshold.
unlock: Have at least the required amount of gold at the end of combat.
Level 7

units.name: Rell
desc: While unmounted, Rhythm Blaster grants a shield and summons 3 speakers for a duration. Each second, they blast a wave that deals magic damage to enemies hit. While mounted, Metal Pony Club slams into a crowd, dealing magic damage to the center enemy and damage split among enemies within 2 hexes.

units.name: Taliyah
desc: Throws rocks at the target, each dealing magic damage. Every few casts, quickly repositions and surfs in a line, dealing magic damage based on enemies’ max Health and briefly knocking up enemies hit.
unlock: Start a champion of each cost in a Beach Pop hex.

units.name: Teemo
desc: Passive: Attacks apply Viral, dealing magic damage over time. Infected enemies become zombies on death, seeking unaffected enemies and exploding to damage adjacent enemies and apply Viral.
Active: Launch a mushroom that applies Viral to enemies within 3 hexes and deals magic damage, reduced for each hex from the center.
unlock: Collect the required amount of Hyperpop Hype.

units.name: Twisted Fate
desc: Passive: At combat start, draw a card for each champion in the shop. If the shop has refreshed this round, gain loot based on the cards drawn: 1 or 2 of a kind grants gold, 3 of a kind grants a random champion, 4 of a kind grants an item component, and 5 of a kind grants a mystery box.
Active: The next 5 attacks gain Attack Speed and are replaced with cards that deal magic damage to the target and 2 nearby enemies.

units.name: Vi
desc: Summon giant hologram fists, gain a shield for a duration, and shield nearby allies. Slam the target repeatedly, dealing physical damage to them and damage to other enemies within 2 hexes.
EDM Upgrade: Slam one additional time and heal for a portion of the damage dealt by this ability.

units.name: Vladimir
desc: Passive: Gain Omnivamp. Debuffed enemies are Captivated.

Active: Deal magic damage to the nearest enemies and Captivate them for a duration. Every few casts, drop a chandelier that deals magic damage to all enemies, reduced for each hex they are from the epicenter. Debuffs include Burn, Wound, Shred, Sunder, Mana Reave, Weaken, Slow, and Vulnerable.
unlock: Field only the specified number of champions in the two front rows of the battlefield.
Level 8

units.name: Zeri
desc: Quickly dashes around the arena, firing lasers in rapid succession at the current target. Each laser deals physical damage to enemies hit and ignores a portion of their Armor.

units.name: Baron Nashor
desc: Summon an 8-member orchestra and a Riff Herald, knocking up all enemies. Deal physical and magic damage split among all enemies. Each minion attacks multiple times, dealing physical damage with each attack.
unlock: Collect all members of Baron's ensemble.
Deal the required damage with your strongest Malzahar.

units.name: Rakan
desc: Dash to a nearby group of enemies, then fling feathers split among enemies within 1 hex, dealing magic damage. Rakan hits enemies within 2 hexes and briefly knocks them up.
unlock: At Level 8+, win or lose the required number of consecutive combats.

units.name: Smeech
desc: Passive: Gain Beats per attack and cast periodically.

Active: Gain a shield and deal physical damage to all enemies within 2 hexes, then strike the current target multiple times, dealing physical damage plus additional damage per Beat. After unleashing a set number of Beats, gain an emblem for a trait you don’t have active; the number of Beats required increases.
unlock: Have at least the required number of non-unique traits active.
Level 9

units.name: Sona
desc: Passive: Cannot attack. Every few seconds, gains Mana, deals magic damage to nearby enemies, and grants allies a Shield for a duration.
Active: Sends a sonic wave across the battlefield, dealing magic damage split among all enemies and Stunning them for a duration. Allies gain a Shield split among them for a duration.
unlock: Inspire Collab champions the required number of times.
Level 10

augments.desc: Each round, gain a 1-star copy of the first champion you killed last combat. The first time the total gold value of champions gained this way reaches the threshold, gain Thief's Gloves.

augments.name: Plot Armor
augments.desc: Your team gains Armor and Magic Resist. After falling below a health threshold, these stats increase for the rest of combat.

augments.name: Portable Forge
augments.desc: Choose 1 of 4 Artifacts. Artifacts are more powerful items with a unique effect.

augments.name: Promised Protection
augments.desc: Gain a Protector's Vow, which grants its holder increased Mana from all sources and increased maximum Health.

augments.name: Randuin's Omen
augments.desc: Gain a Randuin's Omen, which grants Armor and Magic Resist to its holder and nearby allies.

augments.name: Rare Collection
augments.desc: Your team gains Health and Attack Speed for each unique unlockable champion fielded.

augments.name: Replication
augments.desc: Choose 1 of 3 components. Gain a copy of that component over the next few rounds.

augments.name: reroll.exe
augments.desc: At the start of every stage, including this one, gain free rerolls, plus additional free rerolls based on your Hyperpop Hype. Gain a 2-star Ziggs.

augments.name: Reunion Show II
augments.desc: Gain champions, all of whom share a trait.

augments.name: Rock All Nite
augments.desc: Rock champions gain Attack Damage and Ability Power. For every interval the Infernal Idol remains alive, they gain more. Gain 3 Rock champions.

augments.name: Running Wild
augments.desc: At Combat Start, your strongest K/DA champions below the item threshold each receive a temporary recommended item and bonus Health. Gain a Neeko and a Lillia.

augments.name: Sacrificial Dummy
augments.desc: Gain a Training Dummy. While it lives, all damage your champions would take is redirected to it.

augments.name: Salvage Bin
augments.desc: Gain 1 random completed item now, then gain 1 component after a set number of player combats. Selling champions breaks completed items into components, excluding Tactician's items and Emblems.

augments.name: Salvage Bin+
augments.desc: Gain 1 random completed item now, then gain 1 component after a set number of player combats. Selling champions breaks completed items into components, excluding Tactician's items and Emblems.

augments.name: Seraphim's Staff
augments.desc: Gain an Archangel's Staff. It grants its holder additional Mana Regen if they meet the Ability Power threshold.

augments.name: Slammin'
augments.desc: Gain gold. After each player combat, if there are no items on your bench other than consumables, gain XP.

augments.name: Slammin'+
augments.desc: Gain gold and XP now. After each player combat, gain XP if there are no items on your bench other than consumables.

augments.name: Small Squad
augments.desc: When you field a limited number of Heartsteel champions, increase their bonuses. Gain Heartsteel champions.

augments.name: Solo Leveling
augments.desc: For a limited number of upcoming combats, your team size is restricted, but the champion you field has massively increased stats. They gain XP for each kill. Afterward, gain item components.

augments.name: Solo Plate
augments.desc: Gain a Gargoyle Stoneplate. Allies holding a Gargoyle Stoneplate gain bonus Max Health if they start combat alone in their row.

augments.name: Speedy Double Kill
augments.desc: Gain a Guinsoo's Rageblade. Gain gold after a threshold number of players are eliminated.

augments.name: Spirit Of Redemption
augments.desc: Gain a Spirit Visage. Periodically, it heals nearby allies based on their missing Health.

augments.name: Spreading Roots
augments.desc: Gain a random Emblem. After a set number of combats, gain another.

augments.name: Spreading Roots+
augments.desc: Gain random Emblems and gold.

augments.name: Staffsmith II
augments.desc: Gain a random completed item that builds from Needlessly Large Rod now, then gain another in a later round.

augments.name: Stakeholder Management
augments.desc: Gain 2 additional Manager hexes. Managers placed in Manager hexes gain max Health and an additional share of hex bonuses. Gain a Leona after a round-based delay.

augments.name: Stakeholder Management+
augments.desc: Gain 2 additional Manager hexes. Managers placed in Manager hexes gain max Health and increased hex bonuses. Gain a Leona.

augments.name: Star Power
augments.desc: When you 2-star a K/DA champion, gain a free K/DA champion. Gain a Lillia and a Neeko.

augments.name: Stats On Stats II
augments.desc: Gain stat-boosting consumables now and again at regular intervals.

augments.name: Strange Duet II
augments.desc: Allies who start combat isolated in pairs gain Durability and Damage Amp.

augments.name: Submit to the Pit
augments.desc: Allies gain Attack Damage and Ability Power each second they spend in the center 4 rows of the battlefield.

augments.name: Swordsmith II
augments.desc: Gain a random completed item that builds from B.F. Sword now and another in a later round.

augments.name: The Drop II
augments.desc: After a delay in combat, your team heals for a portion of its maximum Health, and enemies take true damage based on their maximum Health.

augments.name: The Golden Dragon
augments.desc: Gain a Mogul's Mail. Champions holding Mogul's Mail take up additional team slots but gain Health and Durability. Mogul's Mail grants gold as well as combat power.

augments.name: Time Skip
augments.desc: Your Shop is disabled temporarily; afterward, you gain XP.

augments.name: Tons of Stats!
augments.desc: Your team gains Health, Attack Damage, Ability Power, Armor, Magic Resist, Attack Speed, and Mana.

augments.name: Trade Sector
augments.desc: Gain a Shop reroll every round and gain gold.

augments.name: Trade Sector+
augments.desc: Gain a Shop reroll every round and gain gold.

augments.name: U.R.F
augments.desc: Gain a Spatula. Champions holding Spatula or Frying Pan items gain Attack Speed and Mana Regen.

augments.name: Verticality II
augments.desc: Champions gain Attack Damage, Ability Power, Armor, and Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

augments.name: Warpath
augments.desc: Gain a 2-star 2-cost champion. After dealing player damage, gain a chest of high-cost champions and items.

augments.name: Weight The Worth
augments.desc: The first time you 3-star a champion, gain a copy of them each round for the rest of the game. 3-starring the same champion again grants additional copies. Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator.

augments.name: Worth the Wait
augments.desc: Gain a random 1-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.

augments.name: Woven Magic
augments.desc: Gain a random item component. As your champions spend Mana, gain additional components at recurring Mana-spent intervals, up to a maximum.

augments.name: Zeke's Herald
augments.desc: Gain a Zeke's Herald, which grants Attack Speed to the holder and allies in the same row within its range.

augments.name: Zz'Rot Portal
augments.desc: Gain a Zz'Rot Portal, an item which summons a large Voidspawn.

augments.name: Arcanist Circlet
augments.desc: Gain an Arcanist Emblem, a Tear of the Goddess, and an Ahri.

augments.name: Arcanist Crown
augments.desc: Gain an Arcanist Emblem, a Jeweled Gauntlet, and a Swain.

augments.name: Band of Thieves II
augments.desc: Gain Thief's Gloves, then gain another after a set number of player combats.

augments.name: Band of Thieves II+
augments.desc: Gain Thief's Gloves, then gain another after a set number of player combats.

augments.name: Band of Thieves II++
augments.desc: Gain Thief's Gloves, then gain another after a set number of player combats.

augments.name: Baron's Lair
augments.desc: Gain a random Tank item. After a delay in combat, your team gains bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power every second for the rest of combat.

augments.name: Beach Pop Circlet
augments.desc: Gain a Beach Pop Emblem, a Sparring Gloves, and a Graves.

augments.name: Beach Pop Crown
augments.desc: Gain a Beach Pop Emblem, a Blue Buff, and a Syndra.

augments.name: Belt Overflow
augments.desc: Gain Giant's Belts. Your Giant's Belts grant bonus Health.

augments.name: Birthday Present
augments.desc: Gain a 2-star champion and gold each time you level up. The champion's cost tier is below your level and capped at a maximum.

augments.name: Booster Box
augments.desc: Gain a pack of champions now and at the start of upcoming stages. At least one holographic is guaranteed!

augments.name: Build A Bud
augments.desc: Gain a random champion and gold.

augments.name: Buried Treasures III
augments.desc: Gain a random item component now and at the start of the next several rounds.

augments.name: Call To Chaos
augments.desc: Gain a powerful and random reward.

augments.name: Celestial Blessing III
augments.desc: Your team gains Omnivamp. Excess healing is converted into a shield, up to a maximum shield size.

augments.name: Cheat Code III
augments.desc: Now and at the start of each stage, get a new cheat code. The first time you perform that exact sequence of actions, gain a reward.

augments.name: Choreographer Circlet
augments.desc: Gain a Choreographer Emblem, a Giant's Belt, and a Garen.

augments.name: Choreographer Crown
augments.desc: Gain a Choreographer Emblem, an Adaptive Helm, and a Syndra.

augments.name: Classical Circlet
augments.desc: Gain a Classical Emblem, a B.F. Sword, and a Jhin.

augments.name: Classical Crown
augments.desc: Gain a Classical Emblem, a Spirit Visage, and a Nasus.

augments.name: Cloning
augments.desc: After each player combat, gain a copy of a random champion on your board. If your board has few unique champions, you may instead gain gold.

augments.name: Comeback Story
augments.desc: Your team gains Health and Attack Speed for each point of player Health you’re missing.

augments.name: Commerce Core
augments.desc: Gain free Shop rerolls immediately and each round for the rest of the game.

augments.name: Component Quest
augments.desc: Gain a random component and gold. The next 7 times you win a player combat, gain a different random component. Afterwards, gain gold.

augments.name: Cursed Crown
augments.desc: Increase your maximum team size, but take double player damage when you lose a player combat.

augments.name: Deadlier Blades
augments.desc: Gain a Deathblade. Deathblades permanently gain Attack Damage each time their holders score a takedown.

augments.name: Deadlier Caps
augments.desc: Gain a Rabadon's Deathcap. Rabadon's Deathcaps grant Mana Regen and permanently gain Ability Power whenever their holders score a takedown.

augments.name: Duplicator Deal
augments.desc: Gain Champion Duplicators. You can no longer 3-star champions.

augments.name: Expected Unexpectedness
augments.desc: Now and at the start of the next 2 stages, roll 3 dice. Gain various rewards based on their total.

augments.name: Flexible
augments.desc: Gain 1 random Emblem. At the start of every Stage, gain a random Emblem. Your team gains Health for each Emblem they are holding.

augments.name: Forged In Strength
augments.desc: Gain a random Artifact. When you drop below a Health threshold, gain more random Artifacts, a random completed item, and random components.

augments.name: Giant and Mighty
augments.desc: Your team becomes large, gaining Health and maximum Health.

augments.name: Golden Gamble
augments.desc: Gain gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain Completed Item anvils.

augments.name: Golden Gamble+
augments.desc: Gain gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain Completed Item anvils.

augments.name: Golden Gamble++
augments.desc: Gain gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain Completed Item anvils.

augments.name: Hard Commit
augments.desc: Gain a random emblem. Now and at the start of each stage, gain a 1-star champion of that trait with a cost equal to the Stage (max 5) and 3 gold.

augments.name: Heartsteel Circlet
augments.desc: Gain a Heartsteel Emblem, a Sparring Gloves, and a Yone.

augments.name: Heartsteel Crown
augments.desc: Gain a Heartsteel Emblem, a Steadfast Heart, and a K'Sante.

augments.name: Hedge Fund
augments.desc: Gain gold. Your maximum interest is increased to 10.

augments.name: Hitmaker Circlet
augments.desc: Gain a Hitmaker Emblem, a B.F. Sword, and a Xayah.

augments.name: Hitmaker Crown
augments.desc: Gain a Hitmaker Emblem, an Infinity Edge, and a Senna.

augments.name: Hold the Line
augments.desc: Allies in your back 2 rows gain Ability Power and Attack Damage for each ally that starts combat in your front row.

augments.name: Illbeats Circlet
augments.desc: Gain an Illbeats Emblem, a Tear Of The Goddess, and a Draven.

augments.name: Illbeats Crown
augments.desc: Gain an Illbeats Emblem, a Gargoyle Stoneplate, and a Braum.

augments.name: Invested+
augments.desc: Gain 26 gold. At the start of each round, gain 1 Shop reroll for every 10 gold above 50 (max 80 gold).

augments.name: Invested++
augments.desc: Gain 45 gold. At the start of each round, gain 1 Shop reroll for every 10 gold above 50 (max 80 gold).

augments.name: Investment Strategy II
augments.desc: Your champions gain permanent max health per interest you earn. Your maximum interest increases, and you gain gold now.

augments.name: Ionic Spark Circlet
augments.desc: Gain an Ionic Spark Emblem, a Needlessly Large Rod, and an Aurora.

augments.name: Ionic Spark Crown
augments.desc: Gain an Ionic Spark Emblem, an Ionic Spark, and an Annie.

augments.name: Jazz Circlet
augments.desc: Gain a Jazz Emblem, a Recurve Bow, and a Bard.

augments.name: Jazz Crown
augments.desc: Gain a Jazz Emblem, a Spear of Shojin, and a Lucian.

augments.name: K/DA Circlet
augments.desc: Gain a K/DA Emblem, a Needlessly Large Rod, and a Leona.

augments.name: K/DA Crown
augments.desc: Gain a K/DA Emblem, a Guinsoo's Rageblade, and a Kai'Sa.

augments.name: Level Up!
augments.desc: Whenever you buy XP, gain additional XP, and gain XP immediately.

augments.name: Living Forge
augments.desc: Gain an Artifact Anvil now, then again at recurring player-combat intervals.

augments.name: Lucky Gloves
augments.desc: Thief's Gloves always give your champions ideal items. Gain Sparring Gloves and gold.

augments.name: Lucky Gloves+
augments.desc: Thief's Gloves will always give your champions ideal items. Gain Sparring Gloves now, then gain another after a set number of player combats.

augments.name: Luxury Subscription
augments.desc: Gain a package containing a champion and a 2-star champion, plus gold. At the start of each of the following stages, gain the package again.

augments.name: Mad Science
augments.desc: Each ally randomly becomes either huge or tiny. Huge units gain max Health, Attack Damage, and Ability Power; tiny units gain Durability and Attack Speed.

augments.name: Management Track
augments.desc: Gain a Manager Emblem. When champions gain bonuses from Manager, you have a chance to gain gold. After collecting gold from the Manager trait, gain a 2-star Dr. Mundo and Warmog's Armor.

augments.name: Manager Circlet
augments.desc: Gain a Manager Emblem, a Chain Vest, and a Leona.

augments.name: Min-Max
augments.desc: Gain a Golden Item Remover, 4 random components, and gold.

augments.name: Money Monsoon
augments.desc: Gain gold now and every round for the rest of the game.

augments.name: Nesting Anvils
augments.desc: Gain an Artifact Anvil. Open it to gain a Component Anvil, then open that to gain gold.

augments.name: Nesting Anvils+
augments.desc: Gain an Artifact Anvil. After opening it, gain a Component Anvil. After opening that, gain gold.

augments.name: One Buff Two Buff
augments.desc: Gain a Red Buff, a Blue Buff, and a Champion Duplicator.

augments.name: Pain into Passion
augments.desc: On the A-Side, True Damage champions gain Attack Speed and Health for each Bling collected. On the B-Side, gain Gold after losing combat. Gain 3 True Damage champions.

augments.name: Pandora's Box
augments.desc: Champions on your board permanently transform into random champions 1 cost tier higher (max 5). Then reforge all of your items, gain a random gold augment, and gain a random completed item.

augments.name: Pandora's Items III
augments.desc: At the start of each round, items on your bench are randomized. Gain Radiant items.

augments.name: Pentakill Circlet
augments.desc: Gain a Pentakill Emblem, a Negatron Cloak, and a Yorick.

augments.name: Pentakill Crown
augments.desc: Gain a Pentakill Emblem, a Giant Slayer, and a Viego.

augments.name: Prismatic Destiny
augments.desc: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and gold.

augments.name: Prismatic Destiny+
augments.desc: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and gold.

augments.name: Prismatic Ticket
augments.desc: Each time your shop is rerolled, you may gain a free reroll.

augments.name: Radiant Rascal
augments.desc: Gain a Radiant Thief's Gloves item. This equips 2 random Radiant items every round.

augments.name: Radiant Relics
augments.desc: Choose 1 of 5 Radiant Items. Gain a Magnetic Remover.

augments.name: Renegade Circlet
augments.desc: Gain a Renegade Emblem, a Sparring Gloves, and an Aurora.

augments.name: Renegade Crown
augments.desc: Gain a Renegade Emblem, a Hand of Justice, and a Qiyana.

augments.name: Rock Circlet
augments.desc: Gain a Rock Emblem, a Needlessly Large Rod, and a Locke.

augments.name: Rock Crown
augments.desc: Gain a Rock Emblem, a Hand Of Justice, and a Camille.

augments.name: Royalties
augments.desc: Gain a Tactician’s Crown. Gain gold every round for the rest of the game.

augments.name: Shimmerscale Essence
augments.desc: Gain a Gambler's Blade, then gain a Mogul's Mail after a set number of player combats.

augments.name: Shopping Spree
augments.desc: When you level up, gain Shop refreshes based on your level. Gain gold.

augments.name: Slayer Circlet
augments.desc: Gain a Slayer Emblem, a Chain Vest, and a Yone.

augments.name: Slayer Crown
augments.desc: Gain a Slayer Emblem, a Titan's Resolve, and a Briar.

augments.name: Soul Awakening
augments.desc: At combat start, your team gains Attack Damage and Ability Power each second. At max stacks, it deals bonus true damage.

augments.name: Star of the Show
augments.desc: Gain a non-Tank champion and an Emblem for one of their traits. At a later stage, gain more copies of that champion.

augments.name: Strange Duet III
augments.desc: Allies that start combat isolated in pairs gain Durability and Damage Amp.

augments.name: Sweet Treats
augments.desc: Gain an Artifact anvil. Your team gains Health for each item equipped to a champion.

augments.name: Swiftstriker Circlet
augments.desc: Gain a Swiftstriker Emblem, a Recurve Bow, and a Bard.

augments.name: Swiftstriker Crown
augments.desc: Gain a Swiftstriker Emblem, a Hextech Gunblade, and a Bard.

augments.name: Sword Overflow
augments.desc: Gain BF Swords. Your BF Swords grant Attack Speed.

augments.name: Tactician's Kitchen
augments.desc: Gain a random Emblem. After a round-based delay, gain a Tactician's Cape.

augments.name: The Golden Egg
augments.desc: Gain a golden egg that eventually hatches and grants a huge amount of loot. Winning player combat advances its hatch timer by one turn.

augments.name: The Immortal Journey
augments.desc: Gain a Xayah, a Spear of Shojin, and gold.

augments.name: The Trait Tree
augments.desc: Gain random Emblems and gold.

augments.name: The Trait Tree+
augments.desc: Gain random Emblems, a Reforger, and gold.

augments.name: Three Steps Ahead
augments.desc: For each of your next player-combat losses, gain a 5-cost champion and components.

augments.name: TONS of Stats!
augments.desc: Your team gains Health, Attack Damage, Ability Power, Armor, Magic Resist, Attack Speed, and Mana.

augments.name: Trait Ladder
augments.desc: Gain a random emblem. In a player combat, field non-unique traits to earn a reward; the trait requirement and reward size then increase.

augments.name: True Damage Circlet
augments.desc: Gain a True Damage Emblem, a Giant's Belt, and an Ekko.

augments.name: True Damage Crown
augments.desc: Gain a True Damage Emblem, an Infinity Edge, and a Senna.

augments.name: Unearthed Treasure
augments.desc: After player combat, each unique Beach Pop champion empowered by a Beach Pop instrument has a chance to uncover some loot! Gain a Taric, a Zoe, and a Renekton.

augments.name: Upward Mobility
augments.desc: Buying XP costs less. Gain Health and Shop rerolls whenever you level up.

augments.name: Urf's Grab Bag
augments.desc: Gain Spatula, random components, and gold.

augments.name: Verticality III
augments.desc: Champions gain Attack Damage, Ability Power, Armor, and Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

augments.name: Wand Overflow
augments.desc: Gain Needlessly Large Rods. Your Needlessly Large Rods grant Attack Speed.

augments.name: We Stick Together
augments.desc: Gain an Emblem for a random trait and a completed item anvil. Allies with that trait gain Attack Speed.

augments.name: Worth the Wait II
augments.desc: Gain 2 copies of a random 2-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.
